IdentifierProtection._comment: Sample keys for local development only. Production keys must come from Key Vault / ExternalSecrets and never enter the repository.

_comment: Local development only. These are the shared dev container credentials, not secrets. Production values come from Key Vault / ExternalSecrets.

BackOfficeSignIn._comment: Local development only, and the only value in this section with no working default. A shipped default would be a key an attacker also has, and a ticket forged under it names any back-office account it likes - so production supplies BackOfficeSignIn__SignInTicketKey from Key Vault / ExternalSecrets and this file is never the source.
